summary: Removing the `@require_role("admin")` decorator from the DELETE endpoint eliminates the only authorization check on a destructive mutation. Cleanup jobs can now succeed, but so can any caller—including viewers—resulting in unauthorized user deletion.

verification.reason: The base revision guards `delete_user` with `@require_role("admin")`, which aborts 403 unless `ROLES.get(user) == "admin"`. Head replaces that decorator with a comment, so any caller can remove entries from `USERS` with no authorization check.
